text:
Samir Patel: heads-up — MarinerRetail onboarding: token burn is up 22% MoM and short chat latencies hitting p95 ~1.2s. most traffic goes to rw-chat-13b-hosted; their SLA wants <500ms for quick commerce prompts. thinking short-term: 1) light canary to rw-chat-6b-q3 for replies <80 tokens 2) route checkout-related endpoints to dedicated pool in their eu-west region 3) enable prefix/KV caching for repeat cart prompts. any objections?

Nina Gomez: totally on board. theyre sensitive to any hallucination increases. can we gate canary with an automatic QA eval on a small prompt set and an option to auto-roll back?

Alex Morgan: yes — rw-chat-6b-q3 showed ~30% cost cut and ~+50-90ms p95 in bench. if we limit to short completions it should be fine. recommend 3% -> 20% ramp. add a quality hook: stop if semantic-similarity drops >2.5%.

Priya Shah: infra note: ensure KV cache warm on dedicated. propose warm-up job that primes top-150 prefixes and an initial jittered traffic ramp to avoid cold bursts. also confirm tokenization parity between models.

Samir Patel: good call. Nina, can you coordinate customer acceptance? Alex, can you prepare the eval set (theyll give 4 sample prompts)? Priya, can you schedule warm-up and add monitoring (kv_hit_rate, p95, p99, semantic_score)?

infra-bot: Acknowledged. Creating canary: route=mariner/6b-q3-canary, traffic=3%, match=path:/v1/chat/*&max_tokens<=80, fallback=rw-chat-13b-hosted, eval_hook=semantic-similarity, rollback_threshold=2.5%. Warm-up job queued: primes top-150 prefixes over 12m. Monitoring alerts set for p95>500ms, semantic_drop>2.5%, kv_hit_rate<65%. Live link: https://console.redwood/inbox/canaries/2290001234

Alex Morgan: eval harness snippet (lightweight): ```json
{"canary":"mariner-6b-q3","prompts":["cart-status","coupon-apply","shipping-eta","item-recs"],"sim_threshold":97}
```

Nina Gomez: I'll get customer signoff today and ask for the 4 high-value prompts. also scheduling 30m enablement after 24h canary for review.

Priya Shah: warm-up started. initial kv_hit_rate=74%, p95 delta=+60ms vs baseline. no immediate rollback.

Samir Patel: ok team, plan: 24h at 3% with eval hook, then ramp to 20% if metrics good. Nina to collect acceptance and store in Gainsight. tag me with any alerts. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Canary reached 24h. Results: traffic=3% over 24h, semantic_delta=-0.9% (ok), cost_estimate_reduction=29%, p95_delta=+72ms, p99_delta=+140ms, kv_hit_rate steady at 78%. No auto-rollback triggered.

Alex Morgan: recommended next step: enable auto-prefix caching for top-300 prompts and roll to 20% over next 48h. will add a canary dashboard card and rollback playbook.

Nina Gomez: customer ok to continue but wants a 72h review window. I'll capture subjective feedback in survey.

Priya Shah: will monitor and post back metrics at 20% ramp.

Samir Patel: thanks all. I'll update the renewal notes with projected savings and attach the dashboard. Closing thread after 72h final checkpoint. :rocket:
